SELECT IFNULL(SUM( CASE WHEN sales_user_id = #{userId} AND sales_status = 1 THEN sales_amount ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN team_user_id = #{userId} AND team_status = 1 THEN team_amount ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN project_user_id = #{userId} AND project_status = 1 THEN project_amount ELSE 0 END ), 0) AS totalAmount,
IFNULL(SUM( CASE
WHEN DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m') = #{queryMonth}
WHEN DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m') = DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y-%m')
THEN (CASE WHEN sales_user_id = #{userId} AND sales_status = 1 THEN sales_amount ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN team_user_id = #{userId} AND team_status = 1 THEN team_amount ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN project_user_id = #{userId} AND project_status = 1 THEN project_amount ELSE 0 END) ELSE 0 END ), 0) AS monthAmount
FROM biz_commission_record WHERE status = 0 AND del_flag = '0' AND ( (sales_user_id = #{userId} AND sales_status = 1) OR (team_user_id = #{userId} AND team_status = 1) OR (project_user_id = #{userId} AND project_status = 1) )
